critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~10.3k lines — Demo Videos endpoints add ~230 more. Consider splitting server.py into routers/ modules; long-term maintainability concern.
DemoVideoUpdate.status validation silently drops invalid values (only accepts 'active' or 'draft') — consider raising 400 instead of ignoring.

Content-type is the only filter on upload — anyone can rename an arbitrary file to .mp4 and set MIME manually; consider magic-byte / ffprobe validation for stronger safety (acceptable for admin-only endpoint though).
delete endpoint uses unlink(missing_ok=True) which is correct but doesn't log when a file it expected to delete was missing — minor observability nit.
seed_data_creation: None persisted — the E2E test created a demo video row + MP4 upload, then deleted both via API. Public list confirmed [] at end.
